world.org_type: housing association (registered provider of social housing) with twelve estates

driver: When events arrive both from a steady background and in short self-exciting runs, each run a burst of events close in place and time that ends once it has played out, a unit's recent count overstates its coming count exactly where a run has just passed, so the coming count follows the unit's background rate, which only separating the run events (each within a short distance and interval of an earlier one) from the rest recovers; projecting whole counts by any persistence, seasonal or smoothing rule names a unit whose run is over instead of the unit whose background has risen.
driver_concrete: Each estate's break-ins over the 13 weeks to 11 October 2026 are projected into the winter programme's 13 weeks from 26 October: Saltersfield's 19 include a run of 10 by one crew along neighbouring doors, each within days and a street or two of the last, and Whinhaugh's 14 a run of 8, both over by the time the grant starts, while Heathfold's 16 are spread across the estate and the weeks, a rise in its background rate; projecting the whole autumn counts names Whinhaugh or Saltersfield, projecting each estate's background break-ins names Heathfold.
stump: A competent solver counts each estate's break-ins in the 13 weeks to 11 October, back-tests persistence, seasonal-ratio, trailing-mean and smoothing projections of those counts over the last eight quarters as the standard's criterion asks, files the best of them and bids for Whinhaugh (Saltersfield on persistence); the step that lands it there is projecting each estate's whole autumn count, when the near-repeat runs (break-ins within days and a street or two of an earlier one, a crew's visit that ends when it moves on) are not what the winter brings and only Heathfold's rise is background, which the projection of each estate's background break-ins finds.
analyst_test: A strong analyst who counts each break-in once by its crime reference, maps every home to its estate through the property register, computes each estate's usual winter exactly and back-tests every projection of estate counts that the standard's criterion invites still projects whole autumn counts and bids for Whinhaugh or Saltersfield, because only separating the near-repeat runs from each estate's background break-ins shows that Heathfold's rise is the one the winter will keep.
domain_test: What decides the call is crime science's near-repeat analysis of residential burglary (a break-in raises the risk to homes within a street or two for a couple of weeks, so a crew working a street leaves a short run that ends, distinct from an estate's background rate), used to project the winter a target-hardening programme will face; with another field's nouns there is no offender returning to neighbouring doors, no near-repeat window and no target hardening, so the task does not read the same.

differentiation.task124: task124 prices newcomers' share of a capped peak from analogs whose measured draw the organisation's own dispatch held down; task181 v3 projects each estate's winter burglary from an autumn count in which near-repeat runs (break-ins within days and a street or two of an earlier one, with no forward yield) are mixed with the estate's background, so the conditioning is on run membership built from the space-time proximity of break-ins, not on an intervention the analogs took part in.
differentiation.task228: task228 v1 set a monitoring rule's false-alarm budget per run when mid-run configuration changes disturbed the nights a run was checked; task181 v3 separates near-repeat burglary runs from an estate's background rate to project the winter, a forward count with no alarm budget and no configuration change.
differentiation.task28: task28 v1 conditioned at-stake volume on a portability property recovered through a credential join; task181 v3 conditions the forward yield of each autumn break-in on whether it belongs to a near-repeat run, a property of its distance and interval to earlier break-ins that no column or join carries.
differentiation.task30: task30 measured a change over only the events the existing procedure leaves unadjusted, found through a catalogue join; task181 v3 adjusts nothing and measures nothing on a subset: it projects the winter from each estate's background break-ins once the runs are separated by proximity in place and time.
differentiation.task32: task32 v1 conditioned each offer's realised delivered cost on the yield of the collection programme behind it; task181 v3's conditioning is the zero forward yield of near-repeat burglary runs against the persistence of an estate's background rate, in a forward projection chosen by a filed back-test.
differentiation.task53: task53 v2 pooled each candidate's eligible volume per account against a scale break a closed offer log draws; task181 v3 has no scale break and no account pooling: the decoy estates' autumn counts are concentrated in near-repeat runs that end, and the answer's rise is background spread across the estate.
differentiation.task33: task33 sent one field team to the syndromic signal whose elevation, carried as a ratio across the expected forward path and stopped at filed interventions, yields most; task181 v3's resolving candidates are near-repeat burglary runs that end by their own dynamics, found only by the space-time proximity of break-ins, with no filed intervention and no ratio carry-forward.

lineage.architecture: draft (never registered): which merchant location gets the acquirer's forensic inspection, exposure counted on contact reads at the device
lineage.fate: redrawn before registration: pick-one-of-N is the spent decision shape on this objective, and the device (contact reads only expose a card) is applied by reflex by a fraud-literate solver
lineage.driver: Exposure to a compromised device happens only on the channels that pass a unit's data through that device, so a common-source screen that counts every visit at the site grain dilutes one compromised device among the site's untouched channels.

lineage.fate: spent at in-house solver round 1 (2026-10-11): one solver, proxy 94.5, landed 387 by explaining the co-visited plaza sites away as subsets of the pump's victims and re-screening the residual; any further rung is dismissed by the same subset check or opens a fork
lineage.driver: Victims of two independent sources are pooled, so the dominant source's victims make the places they also passed look like sources and pull the second source down among ordinary places; only attributing victims to the strongest source first and screening the victims it leaves unexplained separates the second source from the co-visited places, and the exposed population is the union of both sources' exposures.

lineage.fate: spent 2026-10-11: missed at in-house rounds 2 and 3 only while the estimand was open; the portal's determinism QC called the cases-on-file against eventual-count reading a fork, and once PR-07 4.2 filed the eventual count literally, round 4 landed (96.8) by completing each case on its own laboratory's delay; hardening loop 1 (a dated change in the slow laboratory's process) found that any filed criterion choosing the delay history names the step, so the architecture cannot be both literally deterministic and stumped; re-rooted to architecture 3
lineage.driver: When a count is read before its records have finished arriving, the units whose records arrive slowest look quiet exactly while they are surging, so the comparison has to be made on the complete count each unit's own arrival history implies, not on what has arrived, and not on an arrival speed pooled across units.

notes: Re-root of task181 to architecture 3 (the slot's last), drawn 2026-10-11 after architecture 2 was spent under the literal-determinism rule. Anomaly Detection & Diagnostics: the anomaly is each estate's autumn rise in break-ins, and the diagnosis is whether it is a passing near-repeat run or a lasting rise in the estate's background. The filed standard states the estimand literally (break-ins expected in the 13 weeks from 26 October 2026 against the mean of the same calendar dates in the five previous winters) and leaves the projection open behind a back-test criterion (the projection that would have come closest over the eight quarters of its Appendix B, each made from the log at the end of the Sunday two weeks before the quarter began, closeness the total absolute miss over every estate and quarter); the criterion names no method. stump_strategy is forecast_method_backtest rather than decomposition_attribution because what decides is which projection of the forward window the history supports, chosen by the filed back-test; separating run events is the construction inside the winning projection, not an attribution of a reported movement. Pattern A: Saltersfield's and Whinhaugh's runs are resolving, Heathfold's background rise is ongoing. No calibration corpus, no twin case file and no filed decoy: the eight back-test quarters are the log's own history, which the criterion names. Personas drawn with guard.py names (en_GB, seed 181); checked against task180's people on its branch cache (Danish names, no overlap).
